rationale: The plan matches the reference almost exactly: one DESeq2 fit on all twelve samples with ~condition and control explicitly releveled, an omnibus LRT against reduced ~1 for the any-difference question, and the two treatment-vs-control Wald contrasts (plus a secondary arm-vs-arm contrast) drawn from the same dispersion fit, with an explicit prohibition on subsetting and re-fitting. QC (PCA, sample distances, dispersion plot, size factors, p-value histogram) precedes interpretation with a stated outlier policy, and the low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal, justified and reported as genes in/retained. Normalization is inside the model via size factors, though the plan never explicitly rules out pre-normalized input; BH is applied independently per contrast with a note that the three are not jointly corrected, and apeglm/ashr shrinkage is used for ranking with unshrunken values retained for the call, but the alpha is stated as padj<0.05 rather than framed as a threshold set inside the test. Enrichment is well specified (retained-gene universe, symbol matching fraction, seed, redundancy collapse, GSEA on the full ranking) but omits the MSigDB release version and any gene-set size window; the report specification names method, design, thresholds and counts and carries honest design caveats but does not commit to reporting package versions.
